verdict.rationale: Jeeves markets bill pay with smart invoice scanning to capture bills and states that it can 'automate invoice payments and approval flows'. It adds invoice audit trails, employee permissions, scheduled vendor payments, and an MCP tool for reviewing bill pay invoices and managing vendors. The approval-workflow claim, however, rests on a single marketing line. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring approval routing (approvers, rules, multi-step chains), an explicit bill upload flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
